'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Dispatches from the Occlusion Zone''''' is a [[canon]] [[2024]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Daniel José Older]], [[Alyssa Wong]], and [[Cavan Scott]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. The [[The High Republic Adventures – Dispatches from the Occlusion Zone 1|first issue]] was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[October 9]], 2024.
